page.title: Billing
page.description: Billing plan, installments and recurring charges of the project.
page.readOnly: The project is archived: this screen is read-only.

plan.title: Billing plan
plan.description: Billing model and contract amount. Installments are generated from this amount.
plan.empty: There is no billing plan yet: set the model and the contract amount to start.
plan.contractAmountHint: Required for fixed-price and mixed plans. It can stay empty for recurring plans.
plan.snapshotHint: The USD value is fixed when the plan is saved and is not recalculated with later rates.

warning.title: The installments do not add up to the contract amount
warning.description: The installments add up to {installments} and the contract is {contract} (difference {difference}). Review the installments or the contract amount; this warning stays until they match.

templates.label: Quick template
templates.description: Replaces the pending installments with the split of the contract. Billed installments are not touched.

installments.title: Installments
installments.description: Installments of the project in order. A billed installment keeps its amount and currency.

empty.title: No installments
empty.description: Apply a template or add installments by hand.

installments.cancelDescription: The installment “{label}” will be cancelled and will not count toward the contract sum. Billed installments cannot be cancelled.

installmentForm.description: Amount, currency and date of the installment. An adjustment can be negative.
installmentForm.lockedHint: Billed installment: only the label can change.
installmentForm.triggerHint: Free condition, for example “On design approval”.

recurring.title: Recurring charges
recurring.description: Monthly charges of the project. Each period generates its installment a few days before the billing day.

empty.title: No recurring charges
empty.description: Add a monthly, quarterly, half-yearly or yearly charge.

recurring.finishDescription: The charge “{label}” will be finished and will stop generating installments. It cannot be reactivated.

toast.paused: Charge paused: it generates no installments

recurringForm.description: Changing the amount only affects the periods that have not been generated yet.
recurringForm.amountHint: Amount of each period, in the charge currency.
recurringForm.billingDayHint: Between 1 and 28, so it exists in every month.
recurringForm.leadDaysHint: Days before the billing day when the installment is generated.
